messages.subject: Styled product update (HTML mail)
messages.snippet: CSS banner, accent text, and an inline image for reader fidelity checks.
messages.bodyText:
Styled product update

CSS banner, accent text, and an inline image should render in the sandboxed reader.

Open the mobile e2e gallery after a run to compare screenshots.
messages.bodyHtml:
GalMail product update

CSS + HTML should render inside the sandboxed iframe.

This fixture exists so mobile e2e can catch plain-text regressions.

messages.subject: Security keys and recovery
messages.bodyText: Generate a vault key on-device. Keep the recovery key offline. GalMail is not subpoena-proof.
